ambiguity_effects.explain: In Linear issues belong to teams, so 'in the Web team' most naturally constrains the issue, not Maya Chen's membership. All Maya-assigned candidates are in t-web anyway and user team membership is not modeled, so the two readings select the same target.

turn2.differences: No material difference. Author c1-c4 cover the same requirements as step 1: Todo status, assignee Maya Chen, issue in Web team, Bug label from Web team. Step 1 split label presence and label team into two; author combines them in c4, which still requires label team t-web.
turn2.naturalness_note: Plain language using user-visible concepts with no IDs. Duplicate Web team mention is slightly redundant but plausible as emphasis, not a test-only hint.
